trans-unit.source: Read timeout (seconds): how long to wait for a response body before giving up. Empty uses the built-in default.
Connect timeout (seconds): how long to wait for a connection before giving up. Empty uses the built-in default.

Maximum attempts per request: total calls including the first one, so 3 means the original call plus 2 retries. 1 disables retrying. Only timeouts, connection failures and server errors are retried. Empty uses the built-in default.
Run budget (seconds): overall time an import may take before it aborts deliberately and writes its log. Empty uses the built-in default.
Fetch cache lifetime (seconds): how long fetched API responses stay reusable by a later run. Empty uses the built-in default.
